digest.greeting: Good evening, Jean. The day's follow-through remains concentrated on the security, recovery, and rollout decisions already in motion. Two afternoon meetings were canceled, and no checklist items were marked complete today.

items.label: Set the Amazon Connect recovery decision
items.detail: Confirm the Lambda voicemail fix passed full regression testing, Conversation Analytics still works, the workaround is no longer needed, and the evidence for Denver's go/no-go decision is documented. Close the remaining user, skills, queue, deployment, and deadline owners in the same record.

items.label: Remediate the critical Supabase RLS warning
items.detail: Verify the affected public table, enable the intended protections, and confirm the Security Advisor alert clears.

items.label: Turn the MHE requirement into an owned rollout
items.detail: Leadership confirmed that mental health evaluations should be presented as a firm requirement at sign-up once the process is ready, with prior declines re-approached using clear legal guidance. Assign owners and dates for scripts, cost disclosure, re-offer criteria, provider-state coverage, task-set changes, and rollout.

items.label: Reset the Quality intake path with Sara
items.detail: Prepare Friday's follow-up with Sara and Licelot so Quality gaps are evaluated within the larger project context before a new intake is submitted.

items.label: Complete the LeadUp growth-mindset follow-up survey
items.detail: A fresh reminder arrived today for the Module 3 survey. Use a short low-context window or set a firm completion time.

items.label: Confirm the Cross-Firm Lead Intake project name
items.detail: Confirm whether Mar's new project is the item labeled Cross-Firm Lead Intake so the leadership deck and project records stay consistent.

items.label: Legal Projects Portfolio Review was canceled
items.detail: Jean canceled the afternoon review because there were no major updates and returned the time.

items.label: CoE Biweekly Touchpoint was canceled
items.detail: The cancellation notice was sent this afternoon.

items.label: 10:30 AM - Amazon Connect daily standup
items.detail: Bring forward the test evidence and unresolved Denver go/no-go criteria if today's validation did not fully close the recovery decision.

items.label: 11:30 AM to 1:00 PM - Armando 1:1 followed by protected work time
items.detail: Use the open hour after the 1:1 to finish owners or documentation created by today's security, MHE, and portfolio work.

items.label: 1:30 PM to 3:00 PM - BCP and Incident Response followed by Astrid 1:1
items.detail: The BCP and Incident Response touchpoint starts at 1:30 PM, followed by Astrid's 1:1 at 2:30 PM.

items.label: 4:00 PM - Tudo Bem weekly meeting
items.detail: Carry in only the roadblocks and decisions that need the full team's coordination.
